jr: Jr is a son who has the same first name as his father.
Jr means the same as Junior or Jnr.
jra: JRA is a terrorist group organized in 1970 to overthrow the Japanese government and monarchy and to foment world revolution.
For example: "In 1972 the Japanese Red Army was responsible for a massacre at an airport in Israel."
JRA means the same as Japanese Red Army or Anti-Imperialist International Brigade.
Jr. means used of the younger of two persons of the same name especially used to distinguish a son from his father.
Jr. means the same as younger.
